title: E3 Protocol Message Schemas
description: JSON Schema definitions for E3 Application Protocol (E3AP) messages exchanged between dApps (E3 Manager) and E3 Agents, including E3 Service Model (E3SM) payload definitions for the NVIDIA KPM service model.

dAppId.description: dApp identifier assigned by the E3 Agent during setup

messageId.description: Monotonically increasing message identifier generated by the sender

data_stream.description: Data stream descriptor provided inside ranFunctionData of setupResponse

stream_id.description: Stream identifier (e.g., iq_samples, h_estimates, timestamp, sfn, mcs_index)

data_type.description: Data type string (e.g., array(int16), array(complex64), uint64, uint16, uint8, float32)

transport_type.description: How the data is delivered: via shared memory reference or inline in protocolData

memory_size_bytes.description: Size of shared memory region in bytes

keyword.description: JSON field name in protocolData (for inline delivery)

setupRequest.title: E3 Setup Request
setupRequest.description: Sent by dApp (E3 Manager) to E3 Agent via REQ/REP socket to establish connection. The agent assigns a dAppIdentifier and replies with setupResponse.

e3apProtocolVersion.description: E3AP protocol version supported by the dApp

dAppName.description: Name of the dApp (e.g., PRB Power)

setupResponse.title: E3 Setup Response
setupResponse.description: Sent by E3 Agent in reply to setupRequest via REQ/REP socket. On positive response, contains the assigned dAppIdentifier and available RAN functions with their data stream descriptors.

message.description: Error description when responseCode is negative

e3apProtocolVersion.description: E3AP protocol version supported by the agent

dAppIdentifier.description: Assigned dApp identifier (present on positive response)

ranIdentifier.description: Identifier of the RAN node (e.g., NVIDIA_L1)

ranFunctionList.description: List of RAN functions available for subscription

ranFunctionIdentifier.description: RAN function ID (e.g., 1 for NVIDIA KPM)

telemetryIdentifierList.description: Available telemetry stream IDs for this RAN function

controlIdentifierList.description: Available control IDs for this RAN function

ranFunctionData.description: Detailed stream descriptors including delivery method and metadata

subscriptionRequest.title: E3 Subscription Request
subscriptionRequest.description: Sent by dApp to E3 Agent via PUB socket to subscribe to telemetry streams on a specific RAN function. The agent confirms via subscriptionResponse on its own PUB socket.

ranFunctionIdentifier.description: RAN function to subscribe to (must match one from ranFunctionList)

telemetryIdentifierList.description: Telemetry stream IDs to subscribe to (from ranFunctionList)

controlIdentifierList.description: Control IDs to subscribe to (currently unused, send empty array)

periodicity.description: Indication delivery interval in microseconds. 0 = as fast as possible.

subscriptionTime.description: Subscription duration in seconds. 0 = indefinite (until explicit delete).

subscriptionResponse.title: E3 Subscription Response
subscriptionResponse.description: Sent by E3 Agent via PUB socket to confirm or reject a subscriptionRequest or subscriptionDelete. Matched to the original request via requestId. Also used as the response to subscriptionDelete.

requestId.description: id from the corresponding subscriptionRequest or subscriptionDelete

subscriptionId.description: Subscription identifier assigned by the agent (present on positive subscription). Also present in delete responses.

ranFunctionIdentifier.description: RAN function ID (echoed from request, present on positive subscription)

telemetryGrantedList.description: Telemetry IDs actually granted (may differ from requested)

periodicity.description: Granted periodicity in microseconds (may differ from requested)

message.description: Error description when responseCode is negative

subscriptionDelete.title: E3 Subscription Delete
subscriptionDelete.description: Sent by dApp to E3 Agent via PUB socket to cancel an active subscription. The agent confirms via subscriptionResponse.

indicationMessage.title: E3 Indication Message
indicationMessage.description: Sent by E3 Agent via PUB socket to deliver telemetry data to subscribed dApps. The protocolData field contains the actual payload; which fields are present depends on the subscribed telemetry identifiers. Shared memory streams provide buffer indices referencing POSIX shared memory, while scalar streams are delivered inline.

ranFunctionIdentifier.description: RAN function this indication belongs to

protocolData.description: Payload with telemetry streams. Fields present depend on subscribed telemetryIdentifierList.

iq_samples.description: Shared memory reference to IQ sample data (fronthaul)

fh_write_index.description: Current write row in the buffer

pdu_data.description: Shared memory reference to PUSCH PDU data

pusch_write_index.description: Current write row in the buffer

h_estimates.description: Shared memory reference to PUSCH channel estimates (H matrix)

hest_write_index.description: Current write row in the buffer

hest_data_size.description: Number of complex float samples in this estimate

n_bs_ants.description: Number of base station antennas in H estimates

n_layers.description: Number of MIMO layers in H estimates

n_subcarriers.description: Number of subcarriers (PRBs * 12) in H estimates

n_dmrs_estimates.description: Number of DMRS symbol estimates in H matrix

cb_errors.description: Code Block CRC error count per UE

rsrp.description: Reference Signal Received Power per UE in dB

cqi.description: SINR post-equalization per UE in dB

cb_count.description: Number of Code Blocks per UE transport block

rssi.description: Received Signal Strength Indicator per UE group in dB

rb_start.description: Starting resource block within the BWP

start_symbol_index.description: Start OFDM symbol index within the slot (0-13)

dAppControlAction.title: dApp Control Action
dAppControlAction.description: Sent by dApp to E3 Agent via PUB socket to execute a control action on the RAN. The agent may optionally reply with a messageAck.

ranFunctionIdentifier.description: RAN function targeted by the control action

actionData.description: Control payload (contents depend on controlIdentifier and ranFunctionIdentifier)

releaseMessage.title: E3 Release Message
releaseMessage.description: Sent by either dApp or E3 Agent via PUB socket to tear down the E3 connection. Clears all active subscriptions and resets the dApp state. No response or acknowledgement is required; the receiver processes it locally.

messageAck.title: Message Acknowledgement
messageAck.description: Sent by E3 Agent via PUB socket as acknowledgement for received messages (e.g., dAppControlAction). Matched to the original message via requestId.

requestId.description: id from the message being acknowledged

message.description: Error description when responseCode is negative
